Marta: Quick alert — Vela reserved pool scheduled for midnight UTC. Config: 6xA100, soft quota 240k tpm, they anticipate bursts to 300k for short promos. Need a brief ops checklist and a renewal touchpoint afterwards.
Eli: Propose canary ramp: 15m shadow, then 20m at 30%, 20m at 60%, then full for 90m. Also recommend temporary quota bump to 280k for 4h.
Deirdre: Runtime: autoscaler target 68% GPU util. For short bursts we can set scale-out aggressiveness to 35s and keep scale-in 4m. Will enable KV warm for top 5 endpoints and extend TTL to 8h.
Theo: Customer constraints: p99 <160ms and no dropped requests. They want auto-fallback to hosted-us if Dedicated degrades.
Marta: OK set fallback rule: if p99 >240ms for 4m AND queue depth >150 for 2m -> shift 25% incoming to hosted-us and alert ops. Manual approval required to increase cut.
OpsBot: Reminder: maintenance blackout 00:30-03:30 UTC; no infra patches during soak.
Eli: I'll run a short replay using k6 with prod traces at 00:05. Cmd: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 20m tests/vela-replay.js`
Deirdre: Deployed diagnostic header `x-rw-run: vela-midnight` so we can separate routing vs model time in traces.
Eli: Shadow run started. Quick log: "shadow 15m | rps ~4200 | p99 138ms | errs 0"
Marta: Customer ping: "All good so far, can proceed to 30%"
Eli: 30% stage: p99 149ms, gpu util 50%, KV hit 71%.
Deirdre: At 60% stage we saw shard-2 slowdown, queue spiked; autoscaler added a GPU at 00:42 and rebalanced.
Theo: Fallback not triggered. Customer happy. Post-run: schedule renewal check in 2 weeks if sustained >75% usage.
Marta: Actions: (1) note for renewal cadence, (2) update runbook with k6 command and canary stages, (3) open infra ticket to investigate shard-2 hot keying.
Eli: Filing tickets: CS-4812 (renewal cadence), RTE-901 (shard hotkey).
Marta: Thanks team — great coordination.
